page.overview:
Who is Chaz?

Chaz is a male Flip-Flopian that has a unique shape compared to most other Flip-Flopians (especially given he's one of few minor Flip-Flopians to have arms).

Chaz lives in Yold Town where it's said he hangs out with Red even playing cards with him. Chaz can also give out information on how to use each of the hero's abilities.
